title: Environmental sensing network
summary: Design a low-cost network that measures environmental conditions and turns raw readings into useful campus or community insight.
challenge: How can a small team collect reliable data, communicate it clearly, and maintain the system over time?

title: Assistive design studio
summary: Work with a real user or community partner to design a practical tool that improves access, comfort, or independence.
challenge: How do we build with people rather than simply building for them?

title: Small autonomous system
summary: Build a compact robot that can sense its surroundings, make decisions, and complete a clearly defined task.
challenge: How can software, electronics, and mechanics be integrated into one dependable system?

title: Campus energy story
summary: Translate building or energy data into an interactive experience that helps people understand consumption and conservation.
challenge: How can technical data motivate better decisions without oversimplifying the system?

title: Creative technology installation
summary: Create a responsive installation that combines sensors, light, sound, or movement with Oberlin's creative culture.
challenge: What becomes possible when technical practice and artistic inquiry share the same build process?

title: Tools for student life
summary: Build a focused digital tool that removes friction from a real student experience, then test whether it actually helps.
challenge: Can a small product solve one important problem extremely well?
